## Verification

List the commands and platform checks that were run. Explain any applicable check that was not run.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no unrelated cleanup.
- [ ] Architecture and Spec Kit artifacts are updated when boundaries or behavior changed.
- [ ] Generated code came from pinned repository tools and has no unexplained drift.
- [ ] Public/private capability and secret boundaries remain intact.
- [ ] Session compatibility is preserved or explicitly migrated.
- [ ] Relevant success, rejection, cancellation, and cleanup paths are tested.
- [ ] Documentation reflects changed setup, behavior, or platform requirements.
